# API limits

Limits are per API key. Bursts above the limit get HTTP 429.

| Endpoint | Limit | Burst | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /items` | 600/min | 50 | cached at edge |
| `POST /items` | 60/min | 10 | idempotency key required |
| `GET /search` | 60/min | 20 | `q` max 256 chars \| no wildcards |
| `POST /export` | 5/hour | 1 | async; poll `/jobs` |

Contact support to raise a limit.

I updated the `GET /search` row in `docs/limits.md` from `60/min` to `120/min`. The other columns in that row are unchanged, including the escaped `\|` in the Notes cell, so the table still renders correctly.

I didn't change the burst value of 20, because you only mentioned the per-minute rate. If production also raised the burst, that number needs updating too.

`docs/changelog.md` already has a 2026-09 entry saying the search limit was raised, so I left it as is.
